[= accāyika qv ], urgent, pressing; irregular ; Vin III 261, 21 (°-cīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, ~aṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ); Sp 728, 25 (~aṃ idan ti); — °- cīvara , n. , a robe or material for a robe given not at the usual time (because of pressing reasons of the giver) ; Vin III 260, 33 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~aṃ paṭiggahetvā nikkhipitun ti; Sp 729, 1 : ~an ti accāyikaṃ cīvaraṃ vuccati); Sp 1122, 9 ; Vin-vn 864; — anaccekacīvara, n. , what is not an accekacīvara; Vin III 262, 19 ; Sp 729, 26 .

Trsl. l 29). — °-cīvara-sikkhāpada, n., title of Nissaggiya 28 (Vin lll 260—62).
